caption: The shipped 'EBeam Mach-Zehnder Interferometer' example (issue #1310): built only from the SiEPIC EBeam PDK — two grating couplers (left, 0° orientation, vertical 127 µm pitch per openEBL's design-for-test rules), a Y-branch splitter and combiner, and the lower arm stretched by a meander for the visible length difference. The whole design fits the 605 × 410 µm openEBL die; DRC-lite reports no issues.

The grating-coupler test array: gc_in (top, laser on) and gc_out (127 µm below, laser off — listen-only output), both at 0° orientation on a vertical column — the openEBL fiber-array geometry the measurement hardware expects.
